dedupe_keys.name: openstreetmap wiki pipeline data sources links to oil and gas pipeline maps and data by country

description: The OpenStreetMap wiki page Pipeline data sources collects links to pipeline data and maps that are suitable as reference material when mapping pipelines in OpenStreetMap. Its contents cover background and technical information, the Pipeline Open Data Standard link, and country and region sections with maps and data for Brazil, the Caspian Sea region, Egypt, Iran, the Middle East, Libya, Oman, Qatar, Sudan and South Sudan and the United Arab Emirates, among others. Many entries point to EIA country analysis maps marked public domain with credit to EIA, some also as GeoTiff or WMS layers, and to University of Texas library maps that are stated to be in the public domain unless marked with a copyright logo. Access: free web page; the wiki asks users to follow the import guidelines before importing any data, and every listed source keeps its own terms. Coverage is uneven by country. Caveats: this is a pointer list, not a data set, several maps date from 2001 or 2012, and only the page text was read here. It suits network flow and hazard exposure studies of oil and gas transport that need reference geometry, and it relates to the OpenStreetMap record catalogued here as data-openstreetmap.
